build_camera_predictor: build a CameraPredictor module that predicts camera poses from multi-view images using transformer attention
run_camera_forward: run the CameraPredictor forward pass to predict camera parameters from reshaped input images
get_2d_image_features: get 2D image features from a backbone network with positional embeddings and attention blocks
get_backbone_model: get a pretrained DINOv2 backbone model for extracting image features in the camera predictor
predict_pose_encoding: predict pose encoding deltas iteratively using self-attention, cross-attention, and MLP pose branches
